title: Creamy chicken — two-path visual workflow
limitations: This recipe is structured for the VLM-versus-YOLO experiment, not as a complete food-safety guide.
The YOLO path assumes each next step introduces at least one newly visible entity.
Ingredients listed here must exist in the detector vocabulary before the YOLO path is evaluated.

steps.name: Prepare the mushrooms
steps.description: Slice the mushrooms and collect them on the plate.

steps.name: Prepare the onion
steps.description: Chop the onion and collect it in the bowl.

steps.name: Prepare the chicken
steps.description: Cut the chicken into pieces on the cutting board.

steps.name: Heat the oil
steps.description: Add oil to the pan and heat it until ready for the mushrooms.

steps.name: Cook the mushrooms
steps.description: Add the mushrooms to the pan and stir them with the spatula.

steps.name: Add the onion
steps.description: Add the chopped onion and stir it with the mushrooms.

steps.name: Add the chicken
steps.description: Add the chicken pieces and turn them with the tongs.

steps.name: Add the cream
steps.description: Add the cream and stir it into the pan contents.

steps.name: Cover the pan
steps.description: Place the lid on the pan and continue cooking.

steps.name: Serve the dish
steps.description: Move the finished dish to the serving plate.
